subject: Launch window & ops handoff — scheduling and attendee roster
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch window & ops handoff — proposing 90-minute kickoff slots

Hi Eli —

Thanks again for the sync last week. Our post-sales team is ready to run a formal launch kickoff to hand the project from Sales -> Customer Success -> Implementation. To keep this tight, we typically run a 90-minute working kickoff that covers: objectives, roles & contacts, tech preflight, and a 30-day implementation plan.

Proposed windows (your timezone):
- Tue Jun 8, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Jun 8, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Jun 9, 11:00–12:30 PT

Can you confirm which slot works for your core stakeholders and share the attendee list (names + roles) you want present? We’ll bring: a PM, solutions engineer, and an implementation owner.

I attached a short proposed agenda and a blank attendee roster you can edit. Also included a Miro board we’ll use for the timeline exercise.

Attachments: proposed_agenda_v0.2.pdf; cypress_kickoff_attendee_roster.xlsx

Next steps: once you confirm a slot I’ll publish the calendar invite with a Zoom link and prep doc (shared drive).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Sofia —

Appreciate the options. The team prefers Wed Jun 9 11:00–12:30 PT. Attendees below (tentative):
- Eli Navarro (Project Lead)
- Marta Ruiz (IT / SRE)
- Aaron Chen (Security) — may dial in for the security section
- Priya Shah (Product)
- Onboarding alias (onboarding@cypresslabs.com) for admin invites

We don’t need an extended timeline review — focus more on integrations and data flows. Attached is a short org chart.

If you can lock Wed Jun 9 we’ll confirm Aaron after internal sync.

Thanks,
Eli

Eli — thanks, Wed Jun 9 11:00–12:30 PT is locked. Calendar invite sent (Zoom link below). Please confirm Aaron if he will join the security/permissions section — we’ll keep that slot flexible.

Final attendee roster (Redwood):
- Sofia Ivanova — Customer Success (host / objectives, next steps)
- Jordan Blake — Implementation PM (roles, deliverables, timeline)
- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer (integration tech preflight)
- Ben Carter — Onboarding Engineer (access + runbook)

Cypress attendees (as provided):
- Eli Navarro — Project Lead
- Marta Ruiz — IT / SRE
- Priya Shah — Product
- Aaron Chen — Security (TBD)

Agenda (90 minutes):
1) 0–10 min: Introductions & objectives (Sofia)
2) 10–30 min: Project scope & success metrics (Eli + Jordan)
3) 30–55 min: Integration architecture + data flows (Marcus + Marta)
4) 55–70 min: Security & access model (Aaron / Marcus)
5) 70–85 min: 30-day milestones / responsibilities (Jordan)
6) 85–90 min: Next steps & action items (Sofia)

Prework: please upload any API docs, allowed IP ranges, and test dataset notes to the shared doc by Jun 6.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=launch123
Kickoff doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bC3d4E5F6g7H8I9J0k
Miro (timeline exercise): https://miro.com/app/board/uXjV_example

Attachments: final_agenda.pdf

I’ll include the Zoom in the calendar and create a short runbook for Ben to walk through access steps during the call. See you all on Jun 9.

Best,
Sofia
